goal: Test up to 8 combinations of exposure times 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0 s and laser powers 20%, 40%, 60%, and select the condition with the lowest dose among those satisfying signal-to-noise ratio 20 or higher, no detector saturation, and 90% or more of the reference peaks detected.

sample_context.visual_features: Shiny substrate with a distinct feature at x=38.06, y=25.78.

execution_summary.trajectory: Identified sample as Silicon using peak library and reference spectra. Systematically tested combinations of power (20, 40, 60%) and exposure (0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0s). Since the lowest possible dose combination already exceeded all requirements (SNR > 20), it was selected as the optimum.
execution_summary.outcome: Optimal condition identified as 20% power and 0.25s exposure.

lesson: For silicon standard on a shiny substrate, very low dose (20%, 0.25s) is sufficient to achieve SNR > 20. Saturation is not a risk at these powers.

system_metrics.metrics: SNR=54.02, No saturation, 100% ref peaks detected @ Dose=5.0
